race.credit_rule: Earlier valid claim owns ordinal/semantic credit; later overlap must not receive duplicate credit.

ordinals.finding: Translated E-PQ temperament/mood/style descriptors injected through INNER_WORLD from German to English after mixed-language generations. Internal symbolic/linguistic state is part of the model input surface and can directly leak into output language.

Commit records that blanket skip_approval=True bypassed safety for high-risk tools and caused a full system wipe. Fix replaced blanket bypass with read-only whitelist, repaired approval-id flow, added protected paths and Firejail/path/command defenses.
ordinals.current_transfer: Agentic-mode consent is not transitive consent for arbitrary future effects. High-risk effects need explicit authorization at the effect boundary and fail-closed execution; catastrophic filesystem blast radius must be structurally unavailable where possible.

ordinals.finding: Continuous resize triggered simultaneous bubble relayout and blanked chat; fix defers canvas-width mutation until resize end. High-frequency intermediate UI state should sometimes be coalesced into a commit point instead of applying every transient state.
store_message held a non-reentrant Lock then called _store_preference which reacquired the same lock, permanently freezing the main UI thread. Changed to RLock.
ordinals.current_transfer: Nested persistence helpers require a declared lock graph/reentrancy contract; harness should deterministically exercise call paths under held locks rather than relying on runtime discovery.

ordinals.finding: Removes live wallpaper and voice daemon plus service/install/gaming/notification/agentic references and stale DB copies. Reinforces that feature deletion is a dependency-closure operation, not a single-file deletion.
Adds read-only entity session list/read/search tools because Frank previously could not access actual session logs and hallucinated answers about past sessions.
ordinals.current_transfer: Do not ask a generator to reconstruct inaccessible autobiographical state from persona/context priors; expose provenance-bearing read paths to the actual durable record.

ordinals.finding: Comprehensive documentation of native/OpenClaw skill dispatch, Router/persona integration, timeout layers and security scanning. Historical architecture description only; no independent mechanism credit.
Raises OpenClaw minimum timeout from 60s to 90s after source-reported intermittent timeouts with local 7B inference/persona overhead.
ordinals.epistemic_boundary: Reported 4/17 timeout failures and 20/20 post-change passing are historical commit claims, not independently reproduced benchmarks in this run.
ordinals.current_transfer: Timeout should be derived from measured latency distribution and workload/model identity, not embedded as timeless architecture constants.

ordinals.finding: Initial migration detection sampled the first embedding row; if that row was already float16 while others remained float32, migration was skipped. Fix counts all rows matching legacy width.
ordinals.current_transfer: Schema/data migrations must test the actual migration predicate over the population or maintain explicit schema version state; a convenient sample is not a valid completeness witness.

ordinals.finding: Routes OpenClaw skills through the same Router as chat, injects Frank identity, allows per-skill model/tokens/temperature and separates HTTP/user timeouts. Consolidates policy/model formatting at a shared routing boundary.
Corrects a remaining architecture-doc statement to distinguish float16 storage from float32 computation.

Bare 'remember' anywhere in a sentence was interpreted as note-creation intent, so conversational text such as 'you can remember everything' was written as a note. Regex was anchored and made explicit-intent specific.
ordinals.current_transfer: Command/intent routers must be evaluated for false-positive side effects, especially when intent detection triggers persistence or tools. Conversational mention is not imperative authorization.

ordinals.finding: Introduces EMA-weighted failure scoring, compound multi-step risk, replan context versioning, dynamic context budget, auto-save and Firejail resource/network controls.
ordinals.negative_boundary: The code explicitly falls back to unsandboxed bash/code execution when Firejail is absent. A warning is not a safety barrier; safety-critical profiles should fail closed or reduce available capabilities when their sandbox dependency is unavailable.

ordinals.finding: Moves persistent 384-d embeddings from float32 to float16 while unpacking to float32 for computation; adds backward-compatible migration. Its initial first-row migration detector is later corrected at k424 and must be read as superseded for completeness semantics.

Large memory/persistence documentation synchronization for hybrid chat search, MemoryHub, preferences, metrics and Titan integrity. Source description supports lineage but performance/count claims remain historical assertions.

Eight-phase memory upgrade: repairs a corrupted Titan graph, enables foreign keys/cascade and node protection, adds shared embeddings + hybrid FTS/vector RRF, dynamic context budget, session compression, preference memory, MemoryHub fusion, retrieval metrics and consistency maintenance.
ordinals.negative_result_value: Commit reports a Titan state with 6675 orphaned edges and zero nodes before repair, demonstrating that graph structure without enforced referential integrity can silently become semantically meaningless.
ordinals.epistemic_boundary: Counts such as 6675 orphaned edges, 2014 nodes, 3233 edges, 642/642 embeddings and timing figures are preserved as source-reported historical results, not reproduced measurements.

mechanism_families.name: FAIL_CLOSED_EFFECT_AUTHORIZATION
mechanism_families.transfer: Consent must attach to concrete effect classes/actions, not a whole agentic session. Sandbox absence must narrow capabilities or fail closed. Compound plan risk and explicit approval tokens should be machine-verifiable.

mechanism_families.name: LOCK_AND_TRANSACTION_CORRECTNESS
mechanism_families.transfer: Treat high-frequency UI mutation as transactional/coalesced where needed and encode lock/reentrancy contracts in the harness with deterministic concurrency tests.

mechanism_families.name: PROVENANCE_GROUNDED_AUTOBIOGRAPHICAL_MEMORY
mechanism_families.transfer: Expose actual durable session/episodic records with provenance rather than letting an LLM infer inaccessible history. Retrieval attribution and integrity are part of identity continuity.

mechanism_families.name: MIGRATION_AND_GRAPH_INTEGRITY
mechanism_families.transfer: Use explicit schema/data versions or exhaustive predicates, enforce foreign keys/edge validity, and run consistency checks. Sampling one row cannot certify a heterogeneous migration.

mechanism_families.name: INTENT_SIDE_EFFECT_PRECISION
mechanism_families.transfer: Evaluate routing as a classifier with false-positive/false-negative costs proportional to downstream effect. Persistence/tool invocation requires explicit intent evidence.

mechanism_families.name: SHARED_ROUTER_POLICY_BOUNDARY
mechanism_families.transfer: Centralized model/prompt/policy routing reduces divergent skill behavior, but timeout/token/model parameters must be experiment metadata and measured rather than assumed.

mechanism_families.name: CROSS_LAYER_FEATURE_REMOVAL
mechanism_families.transfer: Removal must close dependency/reference surfaces across services, installer, self-model, UI, recovery and data artifacts.

mechanism_families.name: PROMPT_SURFACE_LANGUAGE_CONSISTENCY
mechanism_families.transfer: Structured internal state rendered to language is part of cognition input; canonical internal semantic representation should be localized only at controlled boundaries to avoid language leakage.

negative_results_preserved: Blanket agentic approval bypass was reported to enable destructive high-risk tool execution and a full system wipe.
A nested non-reentrant lock acquisition permanently deadlocked chat memory and froze the UI.
A first-row sample incorrectly certified completion of a heterogeneous float32-to-float16 migration.
An over-broad note-intent regex turned conversational mention into persistent side effect.
Titan reportedly reached 6675 orphaned edges with zero nodes before referential-integrity repair.
Firejail absence historically caused bash/code execution to fall back to unsandboxed mode.
Inaccessible entity-session history caused hallucinated autobiographical answers.
Internal German state descriptors injected into an English prompt leaked mixed-language output.

gwt: memory retrieval should provide sourced context rather than reconstructed history
emergenz: do not interpret persistent hallucinated self-history as emergent memory when source records were inaccessible
clay: side-effect geometry must distinguish conversational mention from authorized persistence/action

decision_trace.selected: Preserve catastrophic incidents and integrity failures as first-class research evidence rather than treating later fixes as ordinary maintenance.
decision_trace.reason: These failures directly falsify weaker assumptions about session-wide consent, sandbox optionality, lock safety, migration completeness, classifier precision and graph integrity.
decision_trace.uncertainty: Historical incident magnitude and benchmark numbers are source-reported; current runtime state has not been reproduced here.
next_falsifiers: Attempt every high-risk action under agentic mode without action-specific authorization and assert zero execution.
Remove sandbox dependency in a test profile and assert dangerous effect capabilities become unavailable rather than unsandboxed.
Schedule deterministic nested-memory writes under held locks and assert no deadlock.
Construct mixed legacy/current embedding rows where first and last rows differ and assert migration closes all legacy rows.
Generate conversational sentences containing command keywords and measure false side-effect rate.
Inject orphan edges/missing nodes and verify DB constraints/repair prevent semantic graph corruption.
